name: Pemayangtse Monastery
description: One of the oldest and most important monasteries in Sikkim, known for its exquisite architecture and serene atmosphere.

name: Rabdentse Ruins
description: Ancient ruins of the former capital of Sikkim, offering panoramic views and a glimpse into the region's royal past.

name: Khecheopalri Lake
description: A sacred lake revered by Buddhists and Hindus, surrounded by lush forests and believed to fulfill wishes.

name: Singshore Bridge
description: The second highest suspension bridge in Asia, offering breathtaking views of the valley and surrounding hills.

name: Rimbi Waterfalls
description: A stunning waterfall nestled in the forest, perfect for nature lovers and photography enthusiasts.

name: Kanchenjunga Falls
description: A beautiful waterfall named after the majestic Kanchenjunga mountain, surrounded by dense greenery.

name: Pelling Skywalk
description: A thrilling glass skywalk offering panoramic views of the Kanchenjunga range and the valley below.

name: Chenrezig Statue
description: A massive statue of the Buddhist deity Chenrezig, symbolizing compassion and peace, set against a scenic backdrop.

name: Tashiding Monastery
description: A sacred monastery perched on a hilltop, known for its spiritual significance and stunning views of the surrounding landscape.

name: Sangachoeling Monastery
description: An ancient monastery offering tranquility and a glimpse into the rich Buddhist heritage of the region.

name: Pelling Market
description: A bustling local market where visitors can experience authentic Sikkimese culture, crafts, and cuisine.

name: Kanchenjunga National Park
description: A UNESCO World Heritage site featuring diverse flora and fauna, alpine meadows, and breathtaking mountain views.

name: Hidden Valley
description: A lesser-known serene valley surrounded by forests and mountains, ideal for peaceful walks and bird watching.

name: Pelling Sky Resort
description: A resort offering adventure activities like zip-lining and rappelling with stunning views of the Kanchenjunga range.

name: Sikkim Himalayan Zoological Park
description: A zoo specializing in Himalayan fauna, including red pandas, snow leopards, and Himalayan black bears.

name: Pelling Sky Garden
description: A beautifully maintained garden with exotic flowers and a peaceful ambiance, perfect for relaxation and photography.

name: Lachung Monastery
description: A quaint monastery known for its vibrant murals and spiritual significance in the region.

name: Pelling Viewpoint
description: A popular spot to catch spectacular sunrise and sunset views over the Kanchenjunga mountain range.

name: Singshore Rock Garden
description: A hidden gem featuring natural rock formations and a tranquil environment away from the crowds.

name: Local Handicraft Workshop
description: Experience traditional Sikkimese crafts and learn from local artisans in an interactive workshop setting.
